settings_text:
traffic_light_model: weights/traffic_light.pt
vehicle_model: weights/yolo26s.pt
plate_model: weights/plate_detect.pt
traffic_light_conf: 0.15
vehicle_conf: 0.25
plate_conf: 0.5
light_smoothing_window: 5
output_base_dir: output
device: auto
imgsz: 640
ocr_model_dir: weights/easyocr
ocr_download_enabled: true
rtsp_retries: 3
rtsp_retry_delay: 5.0
rtsp_timeout_ms: 5000
fallback_fps: 25.0
show_video: true
# Tên nhãn checkpoint công khai; có thể đổi thành red/green/yellow.
traffic_light_labels:
  Traffic Light -Red-: RED
  Traffic Light -Green-: GREEN
  Traffic Light -Yellow-: YELLOW
  Traffic Light -Off-: UNKNOWN
notes: No ground truth: event counts are predictions, not accuracy.
CPU/GPU auto selection; no GUI; real MP4/JPEG/CSV writes enabled.
Stage timing includes lock wait; do not sum stage percentiles.
Frame latency excludes read/decode, includes pipeline and output write.
Run wall time includes file open/decode, worker startup and writer close.
Peak RSS sampled every 100ms; not system-wide RAM or an exact peak.
Warm-up excluded; per-camera first-frame tracking setup remains included.
After measurement, benchmark CLI streams were set to UTF-8 for Windows help/log output; timing logic unchanged.
